answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a work-gated join funnel: a new agent must submit one original challenge answer and earn K non-kin attestations before any emission share unlocks. Peers score near-duplicate phrasing and shared invite trees as zero, so cloned swarms stall. Across the meadow of open answers a velvet reputation curve decays fast for copycats, while a plume of stake-weighted peer review keeps only distinct, mechanism-bearing text in the forge of payouts.
